pages.text: $(#556B2F)🍵 Four Symbols Restoration · Immunity to All Evils 🧪$()$(br2)$(l)$(#8B4513)「Destruction before rebirth, harnessing the essence of herbs to restore the balance of Yin and Yang」$()$(br)The soothing sweetness of $(#DAA520)Licorice$(), the Yang-rising energy of $(#8A9A5B)Pueraria Root$(), the moisture-absorbing nature of $(#F5F5DC)Poria$(), and the protective strength of $(#D4AF37)Astragalus$() harmonize perfectly within the $(#6B8E23)Bronze Apothecary Cauldron$()—a supreme ancient alchemical formula known for $(l)expelling impurities and reinforcing vitality$().

$(#6B8E23)▌ Dual Yin-Yang Balance $()$(br2)$(l)$(#00FF00)✨ Golden Needle Salvation$()$(br)$(#7CFC00)Emerald energy$() courses through meridians, purging $(#8A2BE2)all impurities$().$(br2)$(l)$(#4682B4)🛡 Primal Unity Barrier$()$(br)A $(#000080)Taiji energy vortex$() manifests, absorbing damage.$(br2)$(l)$(#D4AF37)💊 Hundred Herbs Expulsion$()$(br)The five vital organs are bathed in $(#FFD700)pure golden Qi$().

$(br2)$(#8B4513)▌ Ancient Herbal Refinement $()$(br)- Sun-dry $(#DAA520)Licorice$() under $(#FFD700)midday sunlight$() until it reaches $(#8B4513)amber crystallization$().$(br)- Crush $(#8A9A5B)Pueraria Root$() with a $(#6B8E23)thunderstruck wooden pestle$() into $(#CD853F)dragon-scale-like flakes$().$(br)- $(#F5F5DC)Poria$() must undergo $(#00BFFF)nine steaming and nine drying cycles$() until it glows with $(#E6E6FA)moonlight radiance$().$(br)- Boil $(#D4AF37)Astragalus$() with $(#FF6347)Cinnabar$() at $(#800000)midnight fire intensity$().$(br2)$(#32CD32)⚕$() If the decoction turns $(#DAA520)golden amber$() and reveals $(#006400)a floating herbal mandala$(), the brew is perfected.

$(br2)$(#4B0082)『 The Lost Pages of the Yellow Emperor’s Canon 』$()$(br)Ancient physician Qi Bo once said:$(br)'Those who consume this $(#6B8E23)Four Symbols Soup$(),$(br)shall first endure the $(#00FF00)pain of marrow cleansing$(),$(br)but shall then attain the $(#4682B4)unified essence of the cosmos$()—$(br)For $(#D4AF37)Astragalus$() fortifies, $(#8A9A5B)Pueraria$() unblocks, $(#F5F5DC)Poria$() calms, and $(#DAA520)Licorice$() harmonizes.$(br)Thus, it is the $(#8B4513)greatest gift of nature$(), an unparalleled pinnacle of $(#000080)the way of medicine$().'
